pages.text: $(li)Craft a pair of $(l:radiocraft:radios/vhf_handheld)VHF handhelds$(/l): set both to the same frequency and talk.$(li)Then build a $(l:radiocraft:radios/vhf_base_station)base station$(/l) with a $(l:radiocraft:antennas/vhf_antennas)J-pole$(/l) on $(l:radiocraft:antennas/coax)coax$(/l), and $(l:radiocraft:power/overview)power$(/l) to run it.$(li)When you want the world, an $(l:radiocraft:radios/hf_radios)HF radio$(/l) and a $(l:radiocraft:antennas/dipole)dipole$(/l).

pages.name: A VHF base station
pages.text: Solar panels and a charge controller fill the battery, wire takes it to the radio, coax to the J-pole.

pages.title: Putting it together
pages.text: $(li)The $(item)solar panels$() touch each other and the $(item)charge controller$() at the end of the row: no wire between them.$(li)$(item)Wire$() runs from the controller to the $(item)large battery$(), and on to the radio.$(li)$(item)Coax$() runs from the radio to the $(item)J-pole$(). Any length works.$(br2)Panels only charge by day under open sky. Switch the radio on once the battery has some charge.
